Agent Name: WebSurfer  
Step Number: 2  
Reason for Mistake: WebSurfer incorrectly identified "Dirty Diana" as the fifth single from Michael Jackson's sixth studio album, "Bad." The actual fifth single from the album is "Another Part of Me." This incorrect identification led to the analysis of the wrong song's lyrics, resulting in an incorrect solution to the real-world problem. The error occurred in step 2 when WebSurfer provided the fact that "Dirty Diana" was the fifth single, which was not verified or cross-referenced.
